data.case_title: Speeding fine notice from Polizei Berlin (Bußgeldbescheid)
data.explanation: This is a fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) from the Bußgeldstelle for a speeding offense committed on 12 November 2025. It sets a total of €98.50 (fine, fee and expenses) and adds one point to the driving fitness register (Fahreignungsregister). You may file an objection (Einspruch) against it in writing or on record with the Bußgeldstelle; the app shows the deadline computed from the delivery date shown on the return receipt. If you do not object in time, the notice becomes final and the total amount becomes due two weeks after that. Consider legal advice if you want to contest the offense or the speed measurement.

items.title: Decide on an objection (Einspruch) against the fine notice
items.action: Decide whether to file an objection (Einspruch), in writing or on record with the Bußgeldstelle, by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If you do not object, the notice becomes final (rechtskräftig) and the fine becomes enforceable.

items.title: Pay the total fine amount
items.action: If you do not object, pay the total amount by bank transfer once the notice becomes final, quoting the case reference (Aktenzeichen).

items.quote: Der Gesamtbetrag ist zwei Wochen, nachdem der Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist, fällig; geben Sie bei der Überweisung bitte das Aktenzeichen an.
